instructions.title: How this game works
instructions.body: You will play 1 practice season and 8 real seasons. In each season you decide whether to use fertilizer on your maize, and if so, how much. Your harvest depends on the rainfall; your earnings depend on the rainfall and the market price. Both are uncertain, and you will be told the chances before each season.
